Srv\_TrnOnDly

Srv\_TrnOnDly

The turn on delay debounces the false to true transition. This means that if the input is false the output is set to false immediately. The output is set to true if the input has been true for at least the delay time.

 

| Hint | |
| --- | --- |
| This class does not contain sequence numbers for the class methods.  The out value has to be connected to a variable to compute the class.  if the output is used in multiple places, there is a risk that the class output might be calculated twice. To avoid this use a process local variable at the output of the class(incase output is used in multiple places). | |

Example Implementation:

Methods:

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| set\_Time | The internal time value is set to the value provide by TimeVal: |
| out | The method "out" calculates the delay element and delivers the result on the out port of the element. |

Parameter:

| Parameter | Description | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| delayTime | Delay time | sint32 |
| Dt | Dt sample time  Attention:  Dt element and Dt port must have the same conversion formula.  Hint:  If using Per\_Dur as implementation for Dt element in BDE, simulation does not work for time dependent elements. Therefore it is recommended to use Time\_Dt. | sint32 Time\_Dt |
| out | Calculation of delay element and returning result on the out port | uint8 ident(logical signal is returned) |
| return | returns flase if the input is false the output is set to false immediately. returns  true if the input has been true for at least the delay time. | uint8 ident(logical) |
| signal | Input signal | uint8 ident (logical signal is expected at the input) |
| time | static element for holding the time value . | sint32 Time\_Dt  same memory location as set in the TrnOffDly class Settings->Memory Location of Instance |
| timeVal | Time value for initialization of the time value | sint32 Time\_Dt |

| Related information | |
| --- | --- |
| TurnOnDelayA , Srv\_TrnOffDly ,TurnOffDelayA  SRV: SrvX\_TrnOnDlyBoolean\_B  Doors link(SRV): SrvX\_trnOnDly | |
